title: cerasus henryi
intro: Cerasus henryi, commonly known as Chinese plum or cherry plum, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to China. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to protect against chronic diseases such as cardiovascular disease and certain cancers. The therapeutic actions of Cerasus henryi include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
